content:
maria.ryan: Quick check — ACME sent a security questionnaire. Need confirmation on: encryption-at-rest for logs, subprocessors list, whether any logs can contain customer PII and how we redact, and the vendor-access approval path. Also a SOC2 control cross-check. Can someone help?

raj.kumar: Logs are stored in S3 with SSE-KMS; key alias is `alias/redwood-logs` (prod). Access to the KMS key is restricted to the `log-processing` and `infra-admin` roles. Will add exact ARN to the SOC2 pack.

sec-bot: Auto: docs you may need — <https://redwood-internal/docs/security/logging-redaction|Logging & Redaction>, <https://redwood-internal/roster/subprocessors|Subprocessors list>, and <https://redwood-internal/policies/access-requests|Access Request process>.

sophie: For clarity: runtime KV cache is ephemeral and never persisted. Only structured request logs (request id, route, duration, response size) are saved. We strip `authorization` headers before storage and run the redaction pipeline on message bodies.

tim.v: FYI I opened PR #842 to add KMS details + subprocessors snapshot to the SOC2 package: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/842 — @raj.kumar can you review when you have a sec? :eyes:

raj.kumar: On PII — we run an extractor + redactor pipeline. Example rule set we use in the redactor (for customer-facing summary):
```
redaction_rules = [
  r'(?i)ssn[:\s]*\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}',
  r'(?i)credit_card[:\s]*\d{4}[-\s]?\d{4}[-\s]?\d{4}[-\s]?\d{4}',
  r'(?i)\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b'
]
```
We additionally mask emails unless explicitly permitted by the customer.

infra-oncall: Retention notes: customer logs default 90 days, billing/audit 365 days. Subprocessors are documented (AWS, GCP for compute, Sentry for errors, Datadog for metrics/logs). Vendor access approvals: submit the access request page (link above), needs 2 approvers (security + infra/product owner) and a TTL on the IAM creds.

maria.ryan: Thanks — can someone draft a one-liner for the questionnaire we can send back to ACME? Something like: "Logs encrypted at rest with AWS KMS; minimal PII retained and redacted by our pipeline; subprocessors include AWS, GCP, Sentry, Datadog; vendor access requires documented approval and TTL'd credentials." Sound OK?

sophie: +1, I can add that to the responses doc and attach the subprocessors snapshot. Sending in a minute, @maria.ryan :thumbsup:

raj.kumar: I'll add the KMS ARN and a short note about cross-region replication (same key via alias). Also flag: if ACME needs a customer-managed key we can support that via Private deployments.

maria.ryan: Perfect — timeline: need to return ACME's questionnaire by EOD. If any wording or technical details are off, ping me here. /cc @tim.v for the PR review so we can merge artifact into SOC2 pack. Thanks everyone! :pray:
